mostWorthwhile.text: Making the marked collector was most worthwhile because its explanation connected equal collection periods with comparing rainfall over time.

leastWorthwhile.text: The stretch of following one available combination at a time felt predictable, even though it moved the task forward.

surprise.text: Glass and air producing a glass bottle surprised me; I had expected a weather instrument.

arbitrary.text: Glass plus air felt arbitrary because I couldn't see why that pairing would make a bottle.

continue.text: I would be unlikely to continue personally: the weather measurement idea was interesting, but most choices after the opening were prescribed.
